title: 含淳堂 Hanchun Tang
subtitle: Qichun Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 嘉庆 《题含淳堂》 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 一; primary not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 绮春佳境御园东，别有洞天复道通。明善旧题念堂构，含淳新额焕檐栊。
evidence.summary: The hall once named 明善堂 Mingshan Tang gets the new plaque 含淳 Hanchun. Position hint: S220 says 含淳堂 was later renamed 生冬室, so QC48 is an earlier name of QC18 and should stand at QC18.

evidence.title: 《養吉齋叢錄》 on 綺春園 and the Thirty Scenes
evidence.date: Qing; text states events up to 文宗
evidence.excerpt_zh: 綺春園在圓明園東，有複道相屬。舊為大學士傅恆及其子大學士福康安賜園，歿後繳進，嘉慶間始加繕葺。仁宗御製綺春園三十景詩，有宣宗恭跋：先是，園西南以繚垣別界一區，名含暉園，莊敬和碩公主釐降時，賜居於此。公主薨逝，額駙索特那木多布齋以園繳進。舊又橫界一區，名西爽村，有聯暉樓，為成邸寓園。嘉慶間成邸別賜園宅，西爽、含暉皆併入為一園，而規模宏遠矣。舊有數楹名鳳麐洲，後易名清夏齋；問月樓在洲之南，鏡綠亭在洲之北。道光時為尊養孝和皇太后之所，正殿曰迎暉殿。文宗登極，奉康慈太后亦居此，問安視膳，皆如道光間禮。三十景者：敷春堂　鑑德書屋　翠合軒　凌虛閣　協性齋　澄光榭　問月樓　我見室　蔚藻堂　藹芳圃　鏡綠亭　淙玉軒　舒卉軒　竹林院　夕霏榭　清夏齋　鏡虹館　春雨山房　含光樓（即舊時聯暉樓）　涵清館　華滋庭　苔香室　虛明鏡　含淳堂　春澤齋　水心榭　四宜書屋　茗柯精舍　來薰室　般若觀
evidence.summary: The earliest list of the Thirty Scenes we can see, and the history before it seems to come from Daoguang's colophon to Jiaqing's poem set (有宣宗恭跋). It places 問月樓 south of 洲 and 鏡綠亭 north of it, names 迎暉殿 as the main hall of the dowager's residence, and equates 含光樓 with the old 聯暉樓. Punctuation is ours; the print has none. Transcribed by eye.

evidence.title: 毕沅 《春和园纪游》 明善堂 诗序 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.date: 乾隆; S220 gives no year. Describes Fuheng's garden, so before he gave it up
evidence.locator: S220 section 一; primary not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 坐玩鹤亭西望，有石门，如雉堞，东曰归云，西曰舞雪。相羊而入，前跨飞梁，中有曲榭，曰浣香艇。后为清吟书屋，庭列秋槐二株，宵炕昼聂，外有船坞。因命舟师理楫，至锦香亭。白沙如雪，清流玉环，达于明善堂，堂敞七楹，露除霜阙，奎画荧煌。
evidence.summary: A walk through the garden of Fuheng, before Jiaqing rebuilt it. 明善堂 has seven bays, which matches the seven bays of the later 生冬室 on the same site (S43). An older state, not 1860.

evidence.title: Q11 proposal: position hints for the Thirty Scenes
evidence.summary: Hints only. QC37 鏡綠亭: north of the 洲, so on the north shore of QC06 if 洲 means the island, near QC57 浩然亭 (guess). QC40 竹林院 = QC25 延寿寺 (S42 snippet). QC48 含淳堂 = QC18 生冬室 (S220). QC44 涵清館 may be QC07 涵秋館: the seasonal set 敷春, 清夏, 涵秋, 生冬 appears in the list as 敷春, 清夏, 涵清, 含淳 (our inference, C). QC29, QC30, QC31 on the 敷春堂 island (S42 snippet). QC52 般若觀 is also the name of an imperial boat at the 松风萝月 dock (S42 snippet): perhaps no building at all.

evidence.title: 含淳堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.288, under 生冬室; source ref 2-245
evidence.excerpt_zh: 临水轩堂敞，虚明接远天。荷风翻浦荇，竹雾卷溪烟。延爽回廊曲，来薰复径穿。只惭政多阙，淳化未能宣。水榭宜闲眺，招凉四面风。地幽无暑到，境雅有廊通。烟幕柳丝绿，露含荷朵红。偶探长夏景，民瘼每萦衷。
evidence.summary: Poem 含淳堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1803, filed by the editors under 生冬室.

evidence.title: 含淳堂 (绮春园三十景)
evidence.excerpt_zh: 答阳纳影豁平坰，挹爽高堂对碧汀。层叠石峰开牗见，清泠泉磴隔林听。菊芬绕座探幽秀，鸿影横霞入窈冥。写额含淳政难格，闾阎犹未见盈宁。
evidence.summary: One of the Thirty Scenes of 绮春园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805 (S58): the poem 含淳堂.

evidence.title: 含淳堂得句
evidence.locator: v4 p.287, under 生冬室; source ref 2-104
evidence.excerpt_zh: 曲沼冰初解，清波印静心。岸莎新土茁，阶石旧苔侵。淳化嗟难返，春光看渐深。萦怀邪未靖，抚字愧君临。
evidence.summary: Poem 含淳堂得句 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1802, filed by the editors under 生冬室.

evidence.title: 老北京的记忆(79): 绮春园涵秋馆与生冬室, quoting 百景图志
evidence.summary: 涵秋馆 about 1805, added 1810: a seven-bay double 工字 hall with a rockwork fountain between the halls, fed by a raised tank east. 仙人承露台 Xianren Chenglu Tai, a bronze immortal on a high platform, stands near; its base now sits in 中山公园. 生冬室 was 明善堂, then 含淳堂: seven bays with an indoor stage. Today's platform hides 涵秋馆's base.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 绮春园
evidence.summary: Formed from princes' and ministers' gardens, about 54.3 ha. Taken back from Fuheng's heirs and renamed in 1769; gate, tiger-stone wall and 正觉寺 added by 1773, rebuilt in 1795. Jiaqing's growth came in three stages: the western and central groups of the Thirty Scenes first, then the new gate and eastern scenes, finally the south-west (招凉榭, 湛清轩, 畅和堂, 澄心堂, the shrines), gathered as a New Twenty Scenes.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 生冬室
evidence.summary: The core of Prince Yi's garden, with Qianlong's 1740 plaque 明善堂. Jiaqing rebuilt it as 含淳堂 and renamed it 生冬室: seven bays with annexes and a stage inside, used by dowagers. 菡萏榭 stands south-east, and 卧云轩 (also 四面云山), a three-bay open hall, on an islet in the pool.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
